title: Maestro User Identity
description: Persisted by the maestro-onboarding skill (Steps 3 and 3.5). Carries name, role, and — when the user picks the complete track — the rich professional context that drives the CLAUDE.md advisory posture (project ativo / contexto profissional / evolução do OS). Empty strings for focus/work_energy/quality_bar when track = quick.

name.description: Name the user uses at BCG Brasil.

role.description: BCG role (e.g., Consultant, Senior Consultant, Manager).

focus.description: Current project or area of focus. Populated only when track = complete.

work_energy.description: What consumes most energy right now, in the user's own words. Populated only when track = complete.

quality_bar.description: What defines well-done work for the user on this project, in the user's own words. Populated only when track = complete.

track.description: Which onboarding track the user picked. Determines whether focus/work_energy/quality_bar are populated.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the capture.
